notes:
Overview: Sable Harbor Retail is a national direct-to-consumer apparel & home goods retailer (~18M annual orders). Heavy seasonal spikes (Black Friday/Cyber ~10x baseline QPS). Primary goal: replace slow legacy keyword search + boosting with semantic search + reranking to improve conversion on long-tail queries and new arrival merchandising.

Key technical constraints / asks:
- Catalog size: ~15M active SKUs, 45M historical variants; expect 1.5B tokens per month of product text.
- Indexing: want incremental vector index updates (hourly) and ability to reindex subsets during price/seasonal refreshes. Concern: how to handle 15M vectors in Dedicated vs hybrid store (ANN layer + cold store).
- Latency targets: p50 < 40ms for search query path, p99 < 120ms including rerank step. POC QPS target: 1500 qps baseline, 15k qps peak (Black Friday).
- Cost sensitivity: internal goal is < $0.002 per query (incl. embedding lookup + rerank model cost) at steady state; willing to accept higher during short peaks if autoscaling is predictable.
- Model preference: open/quantized embeddings (small footprint) for ANN; candidate reranker can be distilled bi-encoder + light cross-encoder only for top-K.
- Routing/fallback: must support canary fallback to smaller model during overload and region-aware routing for EU shoppers.

Security/compliance notes:
- Must meet SOC2 and SSO/SAML integration. Data residency: EU product data for EU customers. Require KMS integration for key control and audit logs accessible to their security team. Legal wants retention controls per region.

- 2024-09-10: Lead created from trade show. Initial discovery call (owner: Priya).

POC scope (proposed):
- Index ~1.5M representative SKUs (subset) to validate: end-to-end latency, reranker effectiveness (precision@10), and cost-per-query numbers.
- Test traffic: simulated baseline 1.5k qps and controlled 10x spike to validate autoscale and graceful degradation (model fallback to smaller reranker).
- Deliverables: performance bench (latency/cost), integration guide for incremental indexing, policy for EU data residency, and security checklist.
